name: FGO.ro
description: FGO for Claude turns business management into a simple conversation. This MCP server lets users analyze company data and perform key actions such as issuing or canceling invoices, submitting e-Invoices to SPV, and checking ANAF connectivity. It helps monitor e-Factura status, customer overdue balances, supplier balances, and essential reports such as trial balance, monthly profit, and the company’s position with authorities. It is built for entrepreneurs who want faster invoicing workflows and quick financial insights directly inside Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add FGO.ro to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add FGO.ro to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.fgo.ro/ai-api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the FGO.ro MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: FGO.ro lists 25 MCP tools, including cancel_invoice, create_invoice, download_invoice_pdf, get_company_anaf_position, get_current_account_info, get_customer_outstanding_invoices, get_efactura_status, get_invoiced_sales_total, get_latest_trial_balance, get_monthly_sales, get_overdue_customers, and get_partner_statement_link.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to FGO.ro?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to FGO.ro in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
FGO.ro requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
FGO.ro is developed by i-Tom Solutions. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
